metadata.title: Mid-Century Studio Duotone Album Cover
useCases: Podcast cover art for historical series

retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century recording studio aesthetic featuring a grayscale subject isolated against a vibrant duotone background with clean, geometric sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central grayscale figure in profile, wearing mid-century attire, positioned in a recording studio environment. The background is a flat, saturated orange duotone, creating a sharp separation between the subject and the setting. The composition is framed by bold, clean sans-serif text at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Grayscale subject vs. saturated orange background
Vertical microphone element balancing the central figure
Top-aligned thin display type vs. bottom-aligned heavy block type
Studio acoustic panels providing geometric background structure
coreInvariants: Background must be a single-color duotone

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, waist-up profile of a man in a hat, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the vintage condenser microphone.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down to the subject's face, follows the microphone line, and ends at the heavy bottom banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open space around the head to allow the orange duotone to pop.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with neutral, mid-value subject tones.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for display text
High x-height for bottom banner text
Open counters in circular characters like 'O' and 'C'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between light/airy top display and heavy/condensed bottom banner.
graphicDevices: Oval emblem/logo container on the left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, thin-stroke uppercase display at the top.
Matches the heavy, impactful feel of the bottom banner text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grayscale photo of a man in a 1950s polo shirt and fedora in a recording studio with a vintage microphone. Apply a vibrant orange duotone filter to the background studio elements while keeping the man in pure grayscale. Add a solid black bar at the very bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif uppercase text at the top in white. Add bold, condensed sans-serif uppercase text centered in the black bottom bar in white.

verificationChecks: Is the background a uniform orange duotone?
Is the top text thin and the bottom text heavy?
Is the microphone visible and vertically oriented?

adjustableVariables: Background color (e.g., blue or green duotone)
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the oval emblem
Exact facial features of the artist

mustAchieve: Clean separation between grayscale and color
avoid: Color bleeding into the grayscale subject

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges between subject and orange background
Ensure text is perfectly horizontal and centered
Verify the black footer bar is solid and opaque
Confirm the duotone effect doesn't muddy the studio details
recipe.reuseFormula: Grayscale Subject + Saturated Duotone Environment + Geometric Sans-Serif Framing
